name: shipyard
description: Triage into full shipyard or lighter boatyard, then plan, adversarially review, implement in parallel worktrees, polish, review again, ship. Sol reviews each task, with an Opus fallback. Bundles the astra, sol, fable, opus, simplifier, codex, opus-reviewer, sonnet-reviewer, sonnet-implementer, guest-implementer (Gemini 4 Neon via Antigravity, which also lists the polish fixes; CLI wrappers run on Haiku), opt-in mythos and grok reviewers (warn-only when unavailable), the workflow skill that drives them, and /shipyard:doctor to check the CLIs they delegate to.
